senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. preced.) to hide, store away, preserve, esp. to keep dishes warm for the Sabbath.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 2:7">Sabb. II, 7</cite> <he>טוֹמְנִין את החמין</he> you may put warm dishes in the chafing stove &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 1:6">Makhsh. I, 6</cite> <he>הטומן פירותיו וכ׳</he> if one hides his fruits in water against thieves.—
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:8:1">Koh. R. to X, 8</cite> <he>שהוא ט׳ וכ׳</he> that he buried it there; a. e.—Part. pass. <he>טָמוּן</he>.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 5b">B. Kam. 5ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>נזקי ט׳ באש</he> damage caused to things hidden in a pile to which fire was set.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 68">Gen. R. s. 68</cite> <he>היה ט׳ וכ׳</he> he (Jacob) was hiding (before Esau) in the house of Eber; <cite ref="Megillah 17a:5">Meg. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>מוּטְמָן</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="I00556"><he>נטמן</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be hidden, to hide one’s self, to be stored up. Ib. שנ׳ בבית עבר, v. supra.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 3">Lev. R. s. 3</cite> <he>ויִטָּמְנוּ ד״ת בפיך</he> and the words of the Law shall be stored up in thy mouth.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 4:1">Pesik. R. s. 4</cite> <he>נ׳ במערה</he> sought protection in a cave; a. e.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 61b:13">B. Kam. 61ᵇ</cite> <he>שדרכם להַטְמִין וכ׳</he> which it is customary to hide in the stack.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 61b">B. Mets. 61ᵇ</cite> <he>לא יַטְמִין … במלח</he> he must not keep his weights in salt (by which they gain in weight); a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מוּטְמָן</he>, v. supra.

senses.gloss: to hide one’s self, lie in wait.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 79b:2">B. Kam. 79ᵇ</cite> <he>ראוהו שה׳ וכ׳</he> if he has been seen hiding himself in the woods (waiting for a chance to steal).
